name: BSP_FrontEndFrame_SelectLayoutSet
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x164 singleton at 00E18D80, two stack arguments (int set, char commit), RET 8 inferred from the call site at 004c9b85 (no caller-side ADD ESP), not read from the epilogue. Holds three parallel handle arrays with matching .rdata name tables: backdrop this+0Ch / names 00E08500 / 13 slots / set stride 34h; panel this+110h / names 00E08604 / 2 slots / set stride 8; title this+138h / names 00E0862C / 2 slots / set stride 8. Returns at once when set equals this+160h. With commit set it first walks all three arrays slot-major and releases every handle belonging to another set (BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa31f0 when the word at layout+4h is exactly 1, otherwise InterlockedDecrement(layout+4h) with the layout virtual +0h at zero), then fills the requested set's null slots with BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate then 00aa5840(&name, 1, 1), then stores this+160h = set. Tables: set 0 and 1 FE_frame + FE_frame_title, set 2 adds FE_options_bg (backdrop 6) and FE_main (backdrop 12), set 3 GUI_pause + GUI_pause_title, set 4 empty. GGame::OnInitTitle calls it with (0, 1), so the title bring-up loads exactly FE_frame and FE_frame_title through this path. Four callers: 004c9a70, 004c9ca0, 004dfb70, BSP_LoadingScreen_Begin. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md
